Subject: SOC 2 Type II + Trust Portal Access — follow-up & next steps

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Great to meet you both on the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on the security/compliance side: 

1) SOC 2 Type II report: you asked if we can share our most recent Type II — we can. I can send the PDF once the standard NDA/portal access step is done.

2) Bridge letter: we maintain a bridge letter for customers during the gap window between audits; happy to provide that concurrently.

3) Trust portal access: to reduce back-and-forth, we usually invite a 2-3 person team to our trust portal where the report, bridge letter, and control artifacts live. If you can confirm who on your team should have access (names + emails), I’ll request portal invites from our security team.

4) Vendor questionnaire / procurement: I saw a procurement contact on your calendar. If you can drop procurement@auroramed.com on a reply or attach the questionnaire, we’ll have Aditya (SE) and Neha (security) scope answers and an ETA.

Proposed timeline:
- Today: you confirm portal users and attach the questionnaire
- 1-2 business days: we grant portal access and share the SOC2-TypeII-Report-2026.pdf and Bridge-Letter-2027.pdf (redacted where appropriate)
- 3-5 business days: complete initial vendor questionnaire responses (depending on complexity)

If that sounds OK I’ll loop in Neha for the portal invites and Aditya for questionnaire scoping. Thanks again — happy to hop on a short follow-up call if useful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
